input.command:
python3 - <<'EOF'
import re

targets = [
    ("canonical_root", "crates/cli/src/paths.rs"),
    ("contains", "crates/cli/src/paths.rs"),
    ("resolve_recorded_root", "crates/cli/src/main.rs"),
    ("escape", "crates/cli/src/json.rs"),
    ("grammar_versions", "crates/cli/src/store.rs"),
]

for name, path in targets:
    with open(path, "rb") as <LOCAL-PATH> = f.read()
    pattern = re.compile((r"fn %s\(" % re.escape(name)).encode())
    m = pattern.search(data)
    start = m.start() + 3  # skip "fn "
    end = start + len(name)
    line = data.count(b"\n", 0, start) + 1
    print(f"{name} {path}:{line} bytes {start}-{end}")
EOF
